_comment: With the widening limit at 8, each eleven-value array is widened. One name in each is read from process.env, so it may name any key: as a bare name or as a key-shaped object's key, one arrives before the literal values widen the array and one is written after. A lookup through the widened element reaches the service's implementation, so the read method stays and the bundle runs; the unread methods are removed.
